3661-5006-6495-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Shield Sphere is starting in your graveyard.
3661-5006-6495-8170.description:
Cast Shield Sphere by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Shield Sphere spell. Then, activate Evereth by sacrificing Shield Sphere, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth
Repeat.
3661-5006-6495-8170.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

5929-6798-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
5929-6798-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability, causing you to surveil 1.
Repeat from step 3.

1981-2415-2921-4716.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-2921-4716.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

1894-5220-6900-7492.description:
Cast Bile Urchin by paying its mana cost.
Activate Bile Urchin by sacrificing it.
When Bile Urchin dies, Mortuary and Arnyn trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Bile Urchin from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Arnyn trigger, causing target opponent to lose 2 life and you to gain 2 life.
Cast Bile Urchin from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

765-1558-3875-4231-7824.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
765-1558-3875-4231-7824.description:
Play Guildless Commons.
When Guildless Commons enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Bard.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

489-2781-3375-6867.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Felidar Guardian with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Felidar Guardian from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Felidar Guardian enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

1008-1619-2438-4605-5542.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1008-1619-2438-4605-5542.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Undermountain Adventurer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Undermountain Adventurer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Undermountain Adventurer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Undermountain Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Undermountain Adventurer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Undermountain Adventurer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Undermountain Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Undermountain Adventurer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1008-1619-2438-4605-5542.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

255-5147-7124.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
255-5147-7124.description:
Declare The Incredible Hulk and Stangg as attackers.
Stangg triggers, creating a creature token.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature token, dealing 1 damage to The Incredible Hulk.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, then untapping it and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

11-5026.manaNeeded: {U}{U}{R}{R} plus enough mana to cast the additional instant or sorcery
11-5026.easyPrerequisites: You have an additional instant or sorcery card in hand with valid targets as applicable.
11-5026.description:
Cast any instant or sorcery by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Reverberate by paying its mana cost, targeting the instant or sorcery cast in step 1.
Cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, copying Reverberate targeting the spell cast in step 1 and returning the original Reverberate to your hand.
Cast Reverberate by paying its mana cost, copying the copy of Reverberate, targeting the copy of Reverberate.
Resolve the copy of Reverberate, creating a copy of Reverberate targeting the copy of Reverberate.
Repeat step 5.

1824-2530-6556-7350.easyPrerequisites: You have not completed Tomb of Annihilation, nor are currently venturing in it.
1824-2530-6556-7350.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures with power 4 or greater.
1824-2530-6556-7350.description:
Cast Acererak by paying {B}.
Demon's Horn triggers, causing you to gain life.
When Acererak enters, its first ability and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Resolve the Acererak trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat.

7-2438-4907-6989.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures that each have at least one +1/+1 counter on them.
7-2438-4907-6989.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Hamza. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

339-677-5256-7175.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2341-2495-4087.description:
Activate Tezzeret's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, targeting Lavabrink Floodgates and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Holding priority, activate Lavabrink Floodgates by tapping it, adding {R}{R}.
Activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Tezzeret's ability, targeting Lavabrink Floodgates and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Resolve the copy of Tezzeret's ability, untapping Lavabrink Floodgates and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Repeat from step 2.

304-1978-6893.description:
Animate The Eternity Elevator using Tough Cookie.
Activate The Eternity Elevator by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping The Eternity Elevator.
Repeat from step 2.
304-1978-6893.notes: If The Eternity Elevator has twenty or more charge counters on it, you can instead use its second ability to get infinite colored mana. You can also use both interchangeably, if desired.

1085-4053-6798.description:
Cast Chronozoa by paying {3}{U}. It will enter without a time counter on it due to Solemnity.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Chronozoa.
When Chronozoa dies, it triggers, creating two token copies of itself that also enter with no time counters on them due to Solemnity.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat from step 2 using a token copy of Chronozoa instead.

560-1563-2079-2457.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

511-817-3000-3334-4050.description:
Activate Fungal Bloom by paying {G}{G}, putting two spore counters on a Fungus you control.
Activate a Fungus by removing two spore counters from it, creating a 1/1 Squirrel and a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Squirrel and Saproling, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

2558-2921-4186-6701.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Sword of the Meek
When you sacrifice Sword of the Meek, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Squirrel.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.
2558-2921-4186-6701.notes: The combo puts infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel.

394-1445-2511-4871.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
394-1445-2511-4871.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Desecrated Tomb triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

719-1429-5402-5686.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
719-1429-5402-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

2060-3574-4222-4565.notablePrerequisites:
Mikaeus does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Mikaeus.
2060-3574-4222-4565.description:
Activate Mikaeus' second ability by tapping it and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting two +1/+1 counters on each other creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Mikaeus.
Activate Mikaeus' first ability by tapping it, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Mikaeus.
Repeat.
2060-3574-4222-4565.notes: If Mikaeus has a +1/+1 counter on it, you may skip steps 4 and 5 during that iteration.

1365-2829-3263-4853--20.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent was dealt damage this turn.
The creature with bloodthirst does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1365-2829-3263-4853--20.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving the creature with bloodthirst persist until end of turn.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing the creature with bloodthirst.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield, which enters the battlefield with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to its bloodthirst ability.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

277-835-1737-1912-2544.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {0} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Tanglepool Bridge.
When Tanglepool Bridge enters the battlefield, Tiller Engine triggers, untapping it.
Activate the Tanglepool Bridge token by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Filigree Sages by paying {U}, untapping Prototype Portal.
Repeat.

1283-1545-4078-4242-4659.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 4.
1283-1545-4078-4242-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Su-Chi, adding {C}{C}.
When Su-Chi dies, it triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Chainer by paying {3} and 3 life, returning Su-Chi to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Su-Chi enters the battlefield, Trostani triggers, causing you to gain life equal to Su-Chi's toughness.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Lucky Clover

1418-1615-3734.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put an activated or triggered ability on the stack under your control.
1418-1615-3734.description:
Put an activated or triggered ability on the stack under your control.
Holding priority, cast Vantress Visions by paying {1}{U}, targeting the ability.
Phyrexian Metamorph and Lucky Clover trigger.
Resolve the Lucky Clover trigger, copying Vantress Visions, with the copy targeting Phyrexian Metamorph's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Vantress Visions, copying Phyrexian Metamorph's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Phyrexian Metamorph's trigger, copying Vantress Visions, with the copy targeting Phyrexian Metamorph's trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

2034-3652-4871-5105.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ornithopter, adding {C}{C}.
When Ornithopter dies, Sigil of the New Dawn and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Resolve the Sigil of the New Dawn trigger, causing you to pay {1}{W} to return Ornithopter to your hand from your graveyard.
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
Repeat.

2430-3120-5195.notablePrerequisites: Mindsplice Apparatus has at least four oil counters.
2430-3120-5195.description:
Cast Petals of Insight by paying {U}.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Petals of Insight, putting the top three cards of your library on the bottom of your library, and returning Petals of Insight to your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

3975-4374-4918.notablePrerequisites:
Aethergeode Miner does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Aethergeode Miner and Lightning Runner.
3975-4374-4918.description:
Declare Aethergeode Miner and Lightning Runner as attackers, triggering their abilities twice each.
Resolve both Aethergeode Miner triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Resolve the first Lightning Runner trigger, causing you to get {E}{E} and choosing not to pay.
Resolve the second Lightning Runner trigger, causing you to get {E}{E} and pay eight {E} to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

503-3498-3613-4050.description:
Cast Baithook Angler from your graveyard for its disturb cost by paying {U}, causing it to enter the battlefield transformed as Hook-Haunt Drifter.
Kefnet's Monument triggers, tapping a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Hook-Haunt Drifter, adding {U}.
Because Dress Down causes Hook-Haunt Drifter to lose all abilities, it is not exiled when it is sacrificed, and is returned to your graveyard as Baithook Angler.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with a kick counter on it

249-2160-4406.notablePrerequisites: Zethi does not have summoning sickness.
249-2160-4406.description:
Declare Zethi as an attacker.
Zethi triggers, copying all cards you own in exile with kick counters on them and allowing you to cast the copies.
Cast the Chance for Glory copy by paying {1}{W}{R}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and lose the game at the end of the extra turn.
At the beginning of each extra turn's end step, Chance for Glory triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sundial of the Infinite by paying {1} and tapping it, causing you to end your turn and exile Chance for Glory's trigger from the stack.
Repeat each turn.

2232-4068-4103-4747.notablePrerequisites:
Yidaro has been cycled at least three times previously.
You control a Mountain.
2232-4068-4103-4747.description:
Cycle Yidaro by paying {1}{R}, drawing a card and putting Yidaro onto the battlefield from your graveyard.
Yidaro enters, triggering Cloudstone Curio.
Holding priority, activate Alena by tapping it, adding at least eight {R}.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Alena from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Alena for {4}{R}.
Alena enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Yidaro from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

4385-4465.description:
Activate Sliver Queen by paying {2}, creating a 1/1 Sliver token.
Activate the Sliver token by sacrificing it, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.

2018-3693-4053.description:
Cast Walking Ballista by paying {0}.
Walking Ballista enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Walking Ballista from your graveyard to the battlefield without a flying counter due to Solemnity.
Repeat from step 2.
2018-3693-4053.notes: The combo creates a mandatory infinite loop that will cause the game to end in a draw if it isn't interacted with.
